title: Common definitions
description: Shared envelope and primitive definitions referenced by every v1 message schema with "$ref": "urn:fdp:schema:common:v1#/$defs/<name>". This file is never a message on its own; it holds only $defs.

iso_ts.title: ISO timestamp
iso_ts.description: UTC instant with millisecond precision and a literal Z, as written by src/time.ts toIsoMs, Go's 2006-01-02T15:04:05.000Z and Python's strftime equivalent. Epoch milliseconds exist only inside Modbus registers.

unit_id.title: Unit id
unit_id.description: Identifier of a machine in the topic tree. The only unit of this proof of concept is cau-7.

schema_id.title: Schema id
schema_id.description: The $id of a contract schema, repeated in the schema field of every message so a consumer can reject an unknown major.

envelope.title: Envelope
envelope.description: The three fields every MQTT message and WebSocket frame carries. Messages allOf-extend this definition and pin schema with const. Top-level additionalProperties stays true: consumers ignore unknown top-level fields so that a minor version can add one. Nested objects are closed unless a schema says otherwise.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The manual's identifier grammar: lowercase ASCII, digits and underscores, 2 to 40 characters, starting with a letter.

fault_id.title: Fault id
fault_id.description: Identifier of a cause in the fault catalog.

condition_id.title: Condition id
condition_id.description: Identifier of a symptom condition in the fault catalog.

signal_id.title: Signal id
signal_id.description: Tag id of a signal declared in the manual's signal registry.

behaviour_id.title: Behaviour id
behaviour_id.description: Identifier of a behaviour declared under behaviours in the manual's signal registry.

injection_id.title: Injection id
injection_id.description: Identifier of a fault injection offered by the simulator.

symptom_key.title: Symptom key
symptom_key.description: Identifier of the detection rule family that opened an episode.

rule_id.title: Rule id
rule_id.description: Identifier of a single detection rule.

setting_id.title: Setting id
setting_id.description: Identifier of a controller setting declared in the manual's settings registry.

preset_id.title: Preset id
preset_id.description: Identifier of a ground-truth replay preset; kebab-case is accepted alongside snake_case.

instance_id.title: Instance id
instance_id.description: Identifier of one running fault injection, for example inj-3.

alarm_code.title: Alarm code
alarm_code.description: Controller alarm code: W warning, X shutdown warning, S shutdown, M service.

machine_mode.title: Machine mode
machine_mode.description: Operating state derived from the load valve and the motor current.

severity_level.title: Severity level
severity_level.description: Severity bucket assigned to a decision or a ticket.

decision_backend.title: Decision backend
decision_backend.description: Which decision backend produced an answer.

subsystem.title: Subsystem
subsystem.description: The ten subsystems of the manual's component list.

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: A probability mass between 0 and 1 inclusive.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: A non-empty map from candidate key to probability. The keys are fault ids plus none_of_these, or severity levels, depending on the message.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The chosen fault id, or the literal none_of_these when no candidate applies.

manual_ref.title: Manual reference
manual_ref.description: Where a statement comes from in the operator manual.

signal_move.title: Signal move
signal_move.description: One expected movement of a signal or of a derived behaviour, in the manual's vocabulary. Exactly one of signal or behaviour is present. Which directions are valid for which target kind is a referential test, not a schema rule.

sample_value.title: Sample value
sample_value.description: One decoded telemetry value: a number for an analog tag, a boolean for a digital tag.

level_bucket.title: Level bucket
level_bucket.description: Where a signal sits relative to its normal band.

trend_bucket.title: Trend bucket
trend_bucket.description: How a signal is moving over the observation window.

ambient_bucket.title: Ambient bucket
ambient_bucket.description: Ambient temperature bucket at the time of an observation.
